items.title: US market drag keeps Dr Reddy's, Cipla under pressure despite strong product pipeline
items.description: Indian pharmaceutical firms experienced a challenging June quarter, marked by declining US business profits.  Dr Reddy's and Cipla saw significant drops in their net profits and operating margins.  However, their domestic businesses continued to perform well, offering a positive outlook.  Obesity therapies and specialty product launches are expected to drive future growth for these companies.  Analysts have consequently reduced earnings forecasts for the upcoming fiscal years.

items.title: Canara Bank Q1 Results: Net profit rises 2% YoY to Rs 4,856 crore; NII jumps 13%
items.description: Canara Bank Q1 Results: State-owned Canara Bank reported a 2% YoY rise in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 4,856 crore, while net interest income (NII) grew 13% to Rs 10,216 crore. Asset quality improved sharply, with total NPAs declining nearly 24% YoY to Rs 1,399 crore. Total provisions also eased, reflecting continued improvement in the bank's overall balance sheet strength.

items.title: Q1 Results today: Coal India, Tata Power, BEL, Coforge, among 68 companies to announce earnings
items.description: The Q1 FY27 earnings season gathers pace on Monday, with 68 companies set to announce their April-June quarter results. Key names on the radar include Coal India, Tata Power, Bharat Electronics, Godfrey Phillips, Coforge and Canara Bank. Investors will also track earnings from Indus Towers, Tata Chemicals, HUDCO, Happiest Minds Technologies and several other companies across sectors.

items.title: BEL Q1 Results: Net profit rises 9% YoY to Rs 1,054 crore; revenue jumps 25%
items.description: Bharat Electronics reported a net profit of Rs 1,054.53 crore for the first quarter. This marks a nearly 9% year-on-year rise from the previous year's earnings. Revenue from operations grew around 25% year-on-year during the April-June quarter. Sequentially, however, the company's net profit dropped nearly 52% from the prior quarter. Revenue also declined 46% quarter-on-quarter for the period.

items.title: Mangalam Worldwide Q1 Results: Profit rises 19% to Rs 12 crore
items.description: Mangalam Worldwide Ltd has achieved a remarkable 18.7 percent increase in profit after tax for the quarter ending June 2026, accompanied by a total income boost of 13.40 percent. The company has broadened its product offerings to meet evolving customer demands and recently launched a 10.4-MW ground-mounted solar installation. MWL is dedicated to enhancing its value-added stainless steel segments as part of its growth strategy.

items.title: Tata Chemicals Q1 Results: Profit plunges 81% to Rs 60 crore on higher expenses
items.description: Tata Chemicals experienced a significant eighty-one percent drop in profits for the June quarter, primarily due to increased expenses that affected its consolidated net profit. Despite this decline, the total income surged to Rs 4,311 crore, showing improvement compared to the same period last year. As a major player in the industrial and chemical sectors, Tata Chemicals remains a crucial supplier.

items.title: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Q1 profit jumps 35% on strong income growth
items.description: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank reported a 35% year-on-year rise in June quarter net profit to Rs 412 crore, driven by higher income and net interest income. The lender also posted improved margins, stronger asset quality and robust growth in advances and deposits.

items.title: Coal India Q1 Results: Net profit rises marginally to Rs 8,852 crore; PSU announces Rs 5.5 interim dividend
items.description: Coal India Q1 Results: Coal India on Monday reported a consolidated net profit of Rs 8,852 crore for the first quarter of the ongoing financial year 2027, a less-than 1% year-on-year (YoY) rise from Rs 8,797 crore reported in the year-ago period.

items.title: Tata Power Q1 Results: Net profit rises 11% YoY to Rs 1,176 crore, revenue up 6%
items.description: Tata Power Q1 Results: Tata Power on Monday reported a consolidated net profit of Rs 1,176 crore for the first quarter of the ongoing financial year 2027, marking nearly 11% year-on-year (YoY) rise from Rs 1,060 crore reported in the year-ago period.
